summary: Carbon Revolution Public Limited Company, via Form 6-K, disclosed a creditor's winding-up petition filed by UMB Bank (acting through OIC) with the High Court of Ireland on July 31, 2026. Under Section 569(1)(d), the court appointed Grant Thornton Ireland joint provisional liquidators (Nicholas O'Dwyer and Colm Dolan) pending a hearing scheduled for October 19, 2026. The Irish parent lost its Australian subsidiaries after their Voluntary Administration, leaving it with minimal assets and no ability to pay debts. OIC holds principal stockholder status and is the principal creditor. The restructuring in Australia retained senior secured lenders' recapitalization, with OIC funding Irish liquidation. Watch for hearing outcome and liquidator actions.
